title: NSA, CISA and Five Eyes partners publish joint guidance on deploying AI systems securely
publisher: CISA and NSA Artificial Intelligence Security Center
summary: On April 15, 2024 the NSA's Artificial Intelligence Security Center, in collaboration with CISA, the FBI and the national cyber security centres of Australia, Canada, New Zealand and the United Kingdom, published the joint Cybersecurity Information Sheet 'Deploying AI Systems Securely', which gives best practices for organisations deploying and operating externally developed AI systems. The guidance aims to improve the confidentiality, integrity and availability of AI systems, to ensure appropriate mitigations for known vulnerabilities in them, and to provide methodologies and controls to protect, detect and respond to malicious activity against AI systems and related data and services; CISA encourages deployers to review and apply it as applicable.
